criteria.requirement: A playful genuine 3D paper windmill has recognizable folded blades and remains visibly framed.
criteria.action: Inspect the windmill at desktop and phone sizes.
criteria.expected: Recognizable folded 3D blades remain visibly framed.

criteria.requirement: Changing wind speed changes visible rotation, including low and high settings.
criteria.action: Set low and high wind speeds and observe multiple time points.
criteria.expected: Visible blade rotation changes with wind speed.

criteria.requirement: Blade colors can be changed and are reflected in the 3D model.
criteria.expected: The rendered blade colors change to the chosen values.

criteria.requirement: Pause stops rotation, resume restarts it and reduced-motion preference gives a still initial view.
criteria.action: Pause and resume, then open with reduced-motion preference.
criteria.expected: Pause stops rotation, resume restarts it, and reduced-motion initial state is still.

criteria.requirement: Labeled controls and the windmill remain reachable and visible on a phone.
criteria.action: Use all labeled controls in a phone viewport.
criteria.expected: The windmill remains visible and controls remain reachable and understandable.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the folded paper geometry and initial scene.
Change wind speed and blade colors, then observe motion at multiple times.
Pause and resume, inspect a reduced-motion context if supported, and revisit a low-speed state without assuming a particular control design.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
